title: Duality Preserved by Pairwise XOR Construction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, fix an assignment of Boolean values to its $n$ variables, and let a pair of circuits be called dual when the second evaluates to the Boolean complement of the first. Given any list of circuit pairs all of whose pairs are dual, combine consecutive pairs $(p,q)$ into the pair whose first circuit is $(p_1\land q_2)\lor(p_2\land q_1)$ and whose second circuit is $(p_1\land q_1)\lor(p_2\land q_2)$; an unpaired final circuit pair is left as it is. Every pair in the resulting list is dual.
hypotheses_covered: A fixed assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables
Every pair in the input list has second evaluation equal to the complement of its first evaluation
